entries.header: theorem M7.SignatureIdeal.full_signature_ideal : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ a b : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, M7.SignatureIdeal.pairIdeal N a b = M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N (M6.Cyclic.signature a b (M6.Cyclic.modulus N))

entries.header: theorem M7.SignatureIdeal.monic_injective : ∀ (N : ℕ) [NeZero N], ∀ F E : M6.Cyclic.BinaryPolynomial, F.Monic → E.Monic → F ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → E ∣ M6.Cyclic.modulus N → (M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N F = M7.SignatureIdeal.principal N E ↔ F = E)
